title: Pure component dimension from constant finite local dimension
statement: Let Y be a locally noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme; pqf-def-locnoeth], O an open of Y, and n∈ℕ. Assume that every x∈O has local topological dimension [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point] n in Y. Then every irreducible component C of O [def-weil-irreducible-components] has topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] n. Empty O is allowed, and no finite type or global quasi-compactness is assumed.

source.place: Tags 0055 (local dimension) and 0052 (2), (3); open-cover dimension bound in the source library

proof.text: Replace Y by the open subscheme O. Local dimension is preserved by the open inclusion. Since the local dimension n is finite, each point has an open neighbourhood of dimension at most n: the infimum defining local dimension is less than n+1, and dimensions below n+1 are at most n. Cover O by all such opens; the open-cover dimension bound gives dim O≤n. Each component embeds into O, hence also has dimension at most n.

Choose any point of a component C, then an affine member of the canonical affine cover of O containing it. The affine member is noetherian, and its inverse image of C is an irreducible component by the open embedding component correspondence. In a noetherian space there are finitely many components. The complement of the other components is a nonempty open subset of the chosen component (0052 (3)). Its image E in O is open, nonempty, and contained in C. At a point of E, local dimension n≤dim E≤dim C. Combine this with the upper bound. Empty O has no component. This is fully proved in Lean, including the finite-infimum/open-cover argument.

theorem topologicalKrullDim_component_eq_of_constant_local_dimension
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (O : Y.Opens) (n : ℕ)
    (hdim : ∀ x ∈ O, topologicalKrullDimAt x = (n : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (C : Set O) (hC : C ∈ irreducibleComponents ↥O) :
    topologicalKrullDim C = (n : WithBot ℕ∞)
